title: Card Holding Limits Standard — Pocketwire Visa Debit Card
content:
**Card Operations standard.** A customer may hold several Pocketwire Visa Debit Cards at once, within three counts. Each count is read from the tier of the card being issued:

1. no more than the tier's number of physical cards per customer, counting physical cards that are not closed;
2. no more than the tier's number of reusable virtual cards per customer, counting reusable virtual cards that are not closed;
3. no more than the tier's number of single-use virtual cards per calendar month, counting the single-use virtual cards issued to the customer with an issue date in the calendar month of the request.

A request that would go beyond any of these counts is refused, and no card is issued.

A replacement or renewal physical card may be issued while the card it replaces is still blocked or active. The replaced card closes when the replacement is activated, so a replacement or renewal never counts twice against the physical card limit.

## The counts at a glance

| Kind of card | What is counted | Period | Figure used |
|---|---|---|---|
| Physical | Physical cards not closed | at the time of the request | the tier's physical cards per customer |
| Reusable virtual | Reusable virtual cards not closed | at the time of the request | the tier's reusable virtual cards per customer |
| Single-use virtual | Single-use virtual cards issued | the calendar month of the request | the tier's single-use virtual cards per calendar month |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- **Reusable virtual card at the count.** A customer's allowance on the tier being issued is three reusable virtual cards, and three are already open. A fourth would go beyond the count, so the request is refused and no card is issued. If one of the three had been closed, only two would count, and a new one could be issued.
- **Single-use cards across a month end.** On a tier allowing five single-use virtual cards per calendar month, a customer has had five issued this month, so a sixth this month is refused. Cards issued in the previous calendar month do not count towards this month.
- **Replacement while the old card is still open.** A customer's only physical card is blocked, and a replacement physical card is ordered. Both cards exist until the replacement is activated, which closes the blocked card. The replacement is not refused on the physical card count.
